notes.title: News: Introducing the Star monsters
notes.content:
Hi, Warrior!
Introducing the Star monsters in our game!

[h1]Star[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43915075/9af94281e941fa58d64c0cbdd9003bb987d1a3fb.png[/img]

-  It's a yellow star and an angry star that lived in Star Land. Hit the exact moment when the angry star turns into a yellow star!

notes.title: News: Introducing the Ice monsters
notes.content:
Hi, Warrior!
Today, Introducing the Ice monsters in our game
Snowflakes, Wind Wolves, Boulder, and Cores.

[h2]Ice[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43915075/e66d6e2171c4cb9df89afe197bb3182ab015e1f6.png[/img]
- Snowflakes break one by one when hit by an arrow, and they make a grimace when hit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43915075/8f074f4750c5b6110717bee90ccd3ca987a1b8b9.png[/img]
- Wind Wolves raise strong winds to block your arrows. Aim for the moment when the wind isn't blowing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43915075/c597c6a0fa8a8e8fde864f76e2742c32c498d4fc.png[/img]
- Boulders won't break even if hit by arrows until their core is destroyed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43915075/24e7fc3d938716093313b5f4757d1f14575c5971.png[/img]
- Cores are the monsters' power source. Hit them to defeat the monsters!

tags.feature: - Snowflakes break one by one when hit by an arrow, and they make a grimace when hit.
- Wind Wolves raise strong winds to block your arrows. Aim for the moment when the wind isn't blowing!
- Boulders won't break even if hit by arrows until their core is destroyed.
- Cores are the monsters' power source. Hit them to defeat the monsters!

notes.title: SHOOTING STAR VR Patch V1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Note(V1.1.0)[/h1]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[h3][*] Multi-Language Support[/h3]
  - Before we only support English but now we support various languages.
  - Now we support Simplified Chinese.
  - Now we support Korean.
  - Now we support Japanese.
    
[h3][*] Modify UI Interaction effect.[/h3]
 - We noticed that players had a hard time recognizing that they were interacting with the UI.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[h3][*] Fixed tutorial Image scale.[/h3]
 - Some Images in Tutorial did not adequate compared to other images. Therefore we fixed scales to harmonize.
[/list]

Best wishes,
SHOOTING STAR VR Team

tags.feature: - Before we only support English but now we support various languages.
- Now we support Simplified Chinese.
- Now we support Korean.
- Now we support Japanese.
- We noticed that players had a hard time recognizing that they were interacting with the UI.

tags.bug: - Some Images in Tutorial did not adequate compared to other images. Therefore we fixed scales to harmonize.

notes.title: Announcement of SHOOTING STAR VR Release Date
notes.content:
🏹Hello, warrior!🏹

[h1]SHOOTING STAR VR will be released on April 20th![/h1]

[b]Features[/b]
🎯Practice your archery skills in the lobby before embarking on your adventure!
🏰Embark on an adventure-packed stage with 100 different actions.
🏹Try out various archery options!
🌟Something amazing will happen if you light up all the stars scattered throughout the stage.

👇SHOOTING STAR VR will be released for 14.99$! Please add it to your wishlist!👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350290/SHOOTING_STAR_VR/


See you on April 20th, warrior!🏹
